packet.name: Communications Evidence and Processing
transaction_boundaries: PST/OST discovery and parsing occur outside authoritative write transactions through a read-only adapter; unmatched message content exists only in bounded process memory and is discarded after the current inspection unit.

Each accepted processing batch opens one LLD-01 UnitOfWork, revalidates Source Scope/configuration/trackable-target registry and canonical identity, then atomically persists only retained canonical communications, independent links/proposals, durable coverage checkpoint and required audit/results before commit.

Communication-derived domain facts never write another domain directly. The owning-domain command validates CommunicationProposalEvidenceProvider evidence and, in the same caller UnitOfWork, invokes CommunicationProposalDispositionParticipant only after its own mutation succeeds.

Accepted SR terminal handling and confirmed RFC terminal cascade invoke LLD-09 terminal participants inside the owning caller UnitOfWork so frozen summary, direct-link closure and orphan-grace transition are atomic with the accepted governing lifecycle action.

Due orphan purge uses one LLD-01 UnitOfWork per bounded candidate/batch, revalidates every protected dependency immediately before deleting reconstructable content/search material, preserves minimized evidence, audits the result and commits atomically.

MSG draft generation builds and independently verifies bytes outside the authoritative transaction, publishes the verified artifact, then records/reuses immutable draft/export metadata in one short UoW; an already-published matching artifact is reconciled idempotently after DB failure and is never sending evidence.
Long ordinary processing, backfill, Deep Scan, reconciliation and large housekeeping run as LLD-01 durable jobs; checkpoints advance only after committed work.
failure_modes: missing/locked/corrupt/unsupported or partially parseable PST/OST source reports bounded source health and never mutates the source or advances coverage beyond committed provider position/time
no eligible trackable operational entity prevents processing before source content is opened
unknown earliest relevant chronology remains unknown and requires bounded operator lower bound or explicit Deep Scan rather than import/discovery/current time substitution
provider identity absence or fallback collision never silently merges communications; ambiguous candidates remain separate and reviewable
unmatched content, participants, attachments and per-message search material never survive persistence or diagnostics
stale Source Scope/configuration/target revision/proposal evidence aborts the affected authoritative batch or domain acceptance without partial cross-domain mutation
provider terminal RFC evidence, import acceptance or pending cascade never unlinks direct RFC communications

orphan purge cancellation/restart or restored dependency preserves/reinstates retained content during grace and never deletes external PST/OST, MSG exports, portable exports, backups or owning-domain history
job cancellation/crash preserves last committed coverage/checkpoint and never fabricates completion or percentage
diagnostic sanitization uncertainty omits unsafe content rather than persisting message/customer/secrets/path detail
review_evidence: Matched-only retention, path-independent Source Scope identity, canonical multi-entity links, seven-day-default orphan grace, targeted backfill/Deep Scan separation and bodyless terminal summaries are fixed by HLD-10 and the reconciled Communications Contract.
RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant exactly preserves the LLD-03 consumer signature; accepted provider terminal evidence alone cannot invoke its apply path.
CommunicationPanelProjectionProvider is now an exact bounded read-only handoff to LLD-10; CommunicationSummaryProvider remains the LLD-11 summary handoff.
PST/OST parser choice is isolated behind a read-only adapter and has no authority over canonical identity, matching, retention, lifecycle, proposals or coverage semantics.
MSG draft identity remains distinct from later observed sent Communication identity; artifact export is never sending evidence.
The final 100-case suite contains 67 acceptance, 13 failure-injection, 8 privacy/security and 12 adapter-compatibility scenarios with semantically reconciled command/query proof references.
Formal Beta LLD Pass 1 and Pass 2 are both PASS; strengthened cross-packet, durable-job, route and contract-reference gates remain clean.
packet.design_principle: External mail stores are immutable evidence sources. SOMA may inspect them transiently, but persistent reconstructable content exists only for protected accepted matches; all lifecycle effects remain explicit owning-domain actions and all terminal content minimization is revalidated, history-preserving and bounded.

semantics: Limits reject or warn before durable mutation; parser inspection may stream/skip oversized content but never silently truncate identity inputs used by fallback canonicalization.
orphan_grace_minutes measures exact elapsed duration from accepted final-dependency removal; default 10080 minutes equals seven exact elapsed days and is independent of calendar/DST labels.

automatic targeted backfill without added confirmation is allowed only when exact source/identity/range scope is known and requested range is no greater than targeted_backfill_max_days_without_additional_confirmation; every Deep Scan requires explicit confirmation regardless of size.
unknown total work yields count-only progress and no fabricated percentage.

cross_packet_rules: LLD-09 owns source scopes, canonical communications, links, proposal evidence/disposition, coverage, message-content retention, orphan purge, MSG draft provenance and communication summaries.
LLD-09 never changes SR/RFC/WFM/Task/Objective/Inventory lifecycle state; owner commands consume proposal evidence and return result references through the disposition participant.

LLD-03 owns the RFC terminal-cascade orchestration snapshot/impact envelope; LLD-09 supplies only its exact Communications-domain impact page/fingerprint and same-UoW complete-set revalidation through that static contract.
LLD-10 consumes CommunicationPanelProjectionProvider; LLD-11 consumes CommunicationSummaryProvider. Neither stores a competing authoritative communication body/count.

All same-UoW participants use one caller command receipt and never commit/rollback independently. RFC terminal-cascade revalidation is read-only inside that same writer transaction and precedes deliberate-proof consumption/apply.
RFC hard-delete dependency classification is read-only and uses one exact predicate for stable preview snapshots and current writer read contexts.
Proposal contract registration is build-time/static authority only; a parser, message body or runtime extension cannot invent a new owning-domain mutation kind.
Deep Scan deliberate-action proof is supplied and consumed through LLD-12; LLD-09 stores no proof/session secret.
Inventory hard-delete dependency classification is read-only through InventoryCommunicationDependencyProvider; LLD-09 never deletes or rewrites LLD-07 authority to manufacture eligibility.

provided.name: RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant

algorithms/source-scope-identity.json.name: SourceScopeIdentityV1
steps: probe candidate PST/OST through CommunicationSourceAdapter in read-only mode before any authoritative mutation
derive provider account/mailbox identity candidate when adapter exposes stable account/store metadata; normalize with adapter-versioned rule
compare candidate against existing source scopes by adapter_family + accepted scope identity, never by filesystem path/name alone
if exact accepted scope identity exists, offer reviewed location/folder update to that same source_scope_id
if provider identity is unavailable, require explicit operator confirmation of a new OPERATOR_CONFIRMED_LOCAL_SCOPE identity; generate immutable random scope identity independent of path

if overlapping/replacement store may represent an existing scope but evidence is ambiguous, return COMM_SOURCE_SCOPE_CONFLICT and require explicit reconciliation rather than share message identity/coverage
persist configuration only through ConfigureSourceScope and append source-scope event
invariants: rename/move/remount of same confirmed store cannot create a second logical scope
similar filenames/paths cannot merge different mailboxes
source location may change without changing source_scope_id or canonical communication identities
adapter version change never silently reinterprets prior provider checkpoint or identity bytes

algorithms/initial-boundary.json.name: InitialCoverageBoundaryV1
steps: snapshot accepted trackable operational identities and their independently supported effective_from chronology
exclude descriptive/master/reference identities and Local Tasks without accepted external communication identity
if zero eligible identities exist, stop with COMM_NO_TRACKABLE_TARGETS before opening PST/OST content
collect known relevant creation/effective boundaries; do not substitute import/discovery/index/current time for unknown chronology
if every relevant earliest boundary needed to claim historical start is independently known, choose minimum UTC boundary and record evidence fingerprint

if an eligible target that can predate the minimum has unknown chronology, mark historical boundary UNKNOWN and require operator lower bound or explicit Deep Scan; forward processing may still use already established durable high-water when present
later accepted older target compares its known/selected boundary against completed historical/forward coverage and may create targeted backfill without rewinding unrelated forward state
rules: boundary is a coverage decision only and never rewrites owning-domain chronology
operator-selected lower bound is explicit coverage scope evidence, not fabricated entity creation time
unknown remains visible in summaries until covered or explicitly bounded

algorithms/canonical-message-identity.js.name: CanonicalMessageIdentityV1

preferred_identity.source: adapter stable_origin_identity; MAPI RecordKey when exposed as stable provider-origin identity
preferred_identity.normalization: raw identity bytes are not text-normalized; digest=SHA256(kind || 0x00 || raw bytes); normalization_version=1
preferred_identity.rule: transport/MAPI/conversation/entry/artifact identifiers remain separately typed; provider identity is not trusted outside accepted Source Scope

fallback_v1.unicode: UTF-8 after Unicode NFKC; CRLF/CR converted to LF; remove terminal NULs; subject/display strings trim outer Unicode whitespace only
fallback_v1.address: NFKC + trim; ASCII domain lowercased; local-part bytes otherwise preserved; malformed/unknown represented as null plus role/ordinal
fallback_v1.internet_message_id: NFKC + outer whitespace trim; angle brackets preserved when supplied; null sentinel when missing
fallback_v1.body: selected normalized text representation with line-ending normalization only; fallback stores SHA256 of bytes, not body inside identity evidence
fallback_v1.attachments: ordered by source ordinal; each contributes normalized filename|null,size_bytes,content_sha256
fallback_v1.digest: SHA256 of LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical UTF-8 serialization of the fallback object

resolution: same source scope + same provider stable digest reuses existing communication_id after exact evidence check

when stable identity is absent, same fallback digest is a deterministic duplicate candidate; reuse is allowed only when complete canonical fallback object also matches and there is no independent evidence of two distinct source items
otherwise create distinct communication_id values in IDENTITY_COLLISION state and a COLLISION_REVIEW protection hold; never silently merge
later stronger stable identity attaches as identity alias/reconciliation evidence; internal communication_id is never replaced
folder/path/order changes are excluded from canonical identity
rules: hashes are deduplication evidence, never authenticity proof
fallback evidence persists only for retained/protected communications
a collision review can consolidate aliases/links only through explicit audited correction without deleting history
algorithms/canonical-message-identity.js.accepted_conflicting_provider_content: Exact provider identity reuses the canonical ID, but conflicting observed content preserves the retained snapshot and requires reviewed identity reconciliation under COLLISION_REVIEW protection. Exact overlap replays remain unchanged.
algorithms/canonical-message-identity.js.accepted_reviewed_provider_alias: A reviewed provider alias grants reuse of its existing canonical ID only after exact kind/bytes comparison following a digest candidate match; no canonical ID or history is replaced.
accepted_content_acknowledgement: KEEP_RETAINED_CONTENT binds current source revision, exact retained content revision, immutable captured evidence and its hold, whether another protected dependency remains and current grace setting in the preview fingerprint. Indexed existence probes bind this complete retention impact without enumerating unrelated siblings.
The decision only closes its own variant hold, records an immutable event and reevaluates retention in one caller receipt/UoW; retained content, identity and content revision do not change.

An already acknowledged exact evidence row with its unchanged retained snapshot yields truthful NO_CHANGE and its original event ref, without new audit or revisions; eligible receipt replay precedes mutable reads.

Captured source revision remains immutable provenance. A current source revision is separately bound at review; keeping existing content grants no acceptance of new content under a changed configuration.
Exact acknowledged variants cannot supply new automatic matching or domain facts for the retained snapshot. Purged evidence cannot authorize a fresh acknowledgement or automatic restoration.
accepted_pairwise_review: ATTACH_PROVIDER_IDENTITY and CONSOLIDATE_LINKS_AND_ALIASES require two retained snapshots and identical complete fallback evidence, not digests alone; KEEP_SEPARATE transfers no identity or links.

A durable reconciliation job stores its immutable closed review request under an owned job-id row; job payload/checkpoint remain scope/counters only, with no repurposed operational target refs or message content.

Provider alias reassignment is append-only and governed by the review event; exact-key lookup uses the highest per-source assignment revision. Canonical IDs and prior aliases survive; outside-pair ownership fails closed.

Pairwise decisions close only generic collision holds, never separate content-variant/proposal/correction/export holds. Consolidation streams donor links, preserves chronology/direction and revalidates current owner eligibility. Retained snapshots and proposals do not move.

algorithms/matching-retention.json.name: MatchingAndMatchedOnlyRetentionV1
registry: build immutable run snapshot from accepted SR/RFC/WFM/Objective/Spare Request/RMA/Fault Tag identities/aliases
index normalized identity tokens to target identities while preserving owner, target revision, identity kind and effective chronology
master/descriptive data and person/device names never enter the trackable token index
inspection: parse one TransientMessageV1 in bounded memory

scan subject/body and bounded attachment filenames for exact registered identifiers using identifier-family boundary rules; participant addresses may support Contact review but never establish an operational target
for each exact token occurrence collect all registry targets; zero targets means unmatched and all reconstructable content is discarded immediately after counters/checkpoint eligibility are computed
one unambiguous exact current official identifier may use AUTO_SAFE link class when owner validation inside commit UoW returns VALID and no terminal/link/collision rule blocks it
aliases, ambiguous tokens, terminal reassociation, collision state, or any content-derived lifecycle fact produce reviewed proposal/candidate only
commit: open bounded LLD-01 UoW and revalidate source scope/config revision, canonical identity and every proposed target/revision
persist canonical communication content only when at least one link is accepted/safely accepted or a governed proposal/collision/correction hold requires retention
create independent link per target; one message may link to many targets without duplicating content
validate each domain-fact proposal payload through registered proposal contract before persistence
create/maintain RETAINED retention row and protection holds; append audit/results; advance coverage only through committed provider checkpoint
algorithms/matching-retention.json.unmatched_rule: No unmatched subject, body, participant, attachment, per-message index, canonical fallback evidence or source item key may persist; only aggregate scan/job/coverage counts and safe diagnostic codes survive.
accepted_warehouse_review_clarifications: RTYYMMDDxx is optional return-batch context, not an operational identity, item receipt, disposition or event chronology. Missing RT warns the operator without blocking an otherwise valid item-level receipt.
A batch/thread may include items that were not accepted. Exact SR7/C10 and PartNumber/Bomcode context does not replace owner-governed Fault Tag membership and physical-unit validation.

CLOSED wording alone leaves final disposition unresolved. Do not generate an accepted/rejected domain-fact proposal from it; the operator supplies the actual decision and the existing owner command requires explicit confirmation.

registered_match_rules.COMM_EXACT_IDENTIFIER_V1@1: EXACT_IDENTIFIER; current official identifiers may be AUTO_SAFE after writer validation

algorithms/coverage-high-water.json.name: CoverageHighWaterV1
ordinary_run: read current per-folder forward checkpoint and immutable job configuration snapshot
request adapter enumeration from checkpoint with configured bounded overlap; first run uses accepted initial lower bound
process bounded message batch outside write transaction; authoritative match/retention commit uses matching-retention algorithm
inside same successful commit update LLD09 counters and forward checkpoint only through the final provider position whose effects/no-change decisions are durable
on failure before commit, rollback batch and leave checkpoint unchanged; on failure after earlier committed batches, retain earlier checkpoints and mark job partial/failed
overlap replay resolves through canonical identity/link/proposal idempotency and does not inflate counts
coverage_rules: forward high-water is per exact source_scope + folder + adapter checkpoint contract
historical coverage segments are separate and cannot move/reset unrelated forward checkpoint
unknown/unreadable range remains PARTIAL/UNKNOWN with warning; no inferred completion
provider time/position is coverage metadata and never substitutes for message/business chronology
source/folder/profile reconciliation requires reviewed reuse/rescope/reset evidence before checkpoint reuse

algorithms/targeted-backfill.json.name: TargetedBackfillV1
trigger: newly accepted operational identity/alias/reconciliation/effective chronology predates completed relevant coverage
explicit operator request for one or more accepted trackable identities
scope: declared lower/upper chronology or provider-position range
job config revision and adapter version

allowed_when: all scope fields are known and bounded
source health READY/PARTIAL with readable requested range
no Deep Scan semantics are required

execution: enqueue/coalesce TARGETED_BACKFILL durable job without changing ordinary forward high-water
parse/match with identical read-only, canonical identity, matched-only retention, proposal, redaction and commit algorithms used by ordinary processing
record durable historical coverage segments only for committed/readable range
cancellation/failure leaves unrelated coverage untouched and reports partial durable segments
post-purge terminal reversal may request targeted backfill for the exact restored target; if source is unavailable, frozen summary remains and coverage warning is surfaced

algorithms/deep-scan.json.name: DeepScanV1
preview: resolve exact source scope/folders and requested time/provider-position range
show existing coverage and unreadable/unknown portions
estimate messages/bytes/runtime only when adapter can do so without scanning content; unknown estimates remain unknown
show resource impact, retained-match review behavior and that external store remains read-only
bind preview_fingerprint to source scope revision, folder set, adapter version, range, current coverage fingerprint and config revision
authorization: every Deep Scan requires LLD-12 deliberate-action proof bound to action COMMUNICATION_DEEP_SCAN, source_scope_id, revision and preview_fingerprint
startup/scheduler/configuration/device/import/failure fallback can never synthesize or bypass this proof
execution: enqueue DEEP_SCAN durable job using exact preview scope
write historical coverage segments for committed readable work only; do not reset ordinary forward checkpoint
unknown/unreadable intervals remain warning/partial after success

algorithms/terminal-unlink-orphan.json.name: TerminalUnlinkAndOrphanV1
sr_terminal: caller supplies accepted SR terminal event inside owning UnitOfWork
revalidate target/revision and collect current active direct Communication links
derive and insert immutable minimized terminal summary before closing links
close only links with target_type SERVICE_REQUEST and exact sr_id; sibling links survive
for each affected communication, if no active link/hold remains transition RETAINED -> ORPHAN_PENDING_PURGE using accepted terminal event chronology and current grace setting
rfc_terminal: preview may inspect exact LLD-03 terminal cascade proposal snapshot

writer revalidation recomputes the complete current Communication impact set under the LLD-03 caller UnitOfWork and exact-compares reviewed exact_count/provider_fingerprint before deliberate proof consumption

apply is callable only after both cross-domain revalidations READY, deliberate proof consumption and insertion of the outer LLD-03 command receipt; it receives the exact proposal snapshot plus RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionCommandContextV1 carrying command/actor/review provenance and no proof/session secret
freeze RFC summary and close only direct RFC links in the confirmed cascade scope; evaluate affected orphan grace transitions using current protected dependencies
every Communication consequence/history/audit row created by apply is LLD-09 authority and uses command_context.command_id as outer command provenance; no nested receipt/commit/rollback is opened

after all provider-owned writes are assembled compute SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PARTICIPANT_RESULT_V1 over domain COMMUNICATIONS, outer command_id, proposal_id and the complete deterministic ordered immutable result refs plus provider audit_event_ids; return only RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1 with exact result_ref_count, audit_event_count and result_fingerprint

the apply summary is bounded post-apply correlation evidence only; no product/business maximum is imposed on Communication consequence cardinality and complete result identities never cross into the LLD-03 audit payload
provider terminal evidence/import acceptance/pending cascade existence alone never invokes apply
other SR/Inventory/WFM/Objective/Fault Tag links and protected holds survive
reversal: during grace: owner reversal restores governed target link through reviewed owner path, cancels pending purge and preserves prior pending interval history

after purge: canonical identity/minimized summary survive; enqueue exact targeted backfill after commit when source remains configured/readable; unavailable reconstruction keeps summary plus coverage warning
algorithms/terminal-unlink-orphan.json.hard_delete: RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant.classify_hard_delete_dependency returns BLOCKED while any retained/purged communication history, link/proposal/terminal-summary/protection evidence requires RFC identity; INDETERMINATE fails closed.
accepted_owner_clarifications: SR governing event is the accepted status-observation UUID; grace starts at recorded_at_utc, never the possibly old or unknown provider chronology.
RFC grace starts at the accepted local cascade execution time.
RFC governing_event_id is the accepted cascade proposal UUID; LLD-03 supplies its exact accepted_execution_utc through the existing command context, required by Communications apply.
SR apply returns the immutable frozen-summary reference; complete consequences stay relational under the outer command.

Post-purge reversal atomically enqueues exact reconstruction in caller UoW, runnable only after commit; worker revalidates readability. Unproved range or unavailable source leaves frozen evidence and coverage warning.

algorithms/due-purge.json.name: DueOrphanPurgeV1
algorithms/due-purge.json.selection: keyset-select ORPHAN_PENDING_PURGE rows with purge_due_utc<=now ordered by due,communication_id; bounded batch; selection is advisory only
per_communication: open LLD-01 UnitOfWork and reread retention revision/state/due
revalidate current active communication links and every active protection hold using indexed reads
if any dependency exists, transition back to RETAINED/cancel purge and audit safe result
if due changed/not reached, return NO_CHANGE
capture minimized purge evidence/fingerprints needed by retention history; never copy body/subject/participant/attachment names into purge record
delete attachment chunks/metadata, participants, FTS row, body and subject; set communications.content_state=PURGED and retention state=PURGED with revision increments
safety: all known application instants used by retention are canonical UTC whole seconds
external PST/OST is never opened for purge
MSG files, portable exports and existing backups are never deleted/modified
operational entities, link/proposal/event/audit history and frozen terminal summaries remain
crash before commit leaves content intact; committed purge is idempotent on restart
housekeeping scheduler runs even when communication fetching is disabled

algorithms/msg-draft.json.name: MsgDraftGenerationV1
steps: validate bounded recipients/content/destination and compute content_fingerprint from StrictVersionedJson semantic input
build IPM.Note bytes with msgforge 1.0.0 outside DB transaction; sent flag false; no send API/COM/Outlook invocation
verify CFB/OXMSG structure with independent verifier and compute final artifact SHA-256/byte length
publish the verified file atomically to the operator-selected destination; never overwrite a protected PST/OST source path
inside one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork resolve committed replay/idempotency and reconcile any already-published artifact with the same semantic draft key/hash

insert one command_receipt before receipt-FK children, then insert/reuse immutable msg_draft identity by origin_command_id + content_fingerprint, ordered recipient snapshot, export metadata, audit/results and commit

if publication fails no DB draft/export mutation occurs; if publication succeeds but DB commit fails, retry with the same command/semantic input verifies the published artifact hash and records/reuses the same semantic draft without creating sent Communication
later PST/OST discovery follows normal CanonicalMessageIdentityV1; reviewed reconciliation may set reconciled_communication_id but draft identity remains distinct
rules: draft/export never changes source coverage/high-water or communication sent counts
artifact filename/path never proves sending
draft bodies are local authored evidence, not provider source evidence
the final authoritative DB mutation uses exactly one short transaction after artifact verification/publication; there is no earlier draft-provenance transaction
